svg.title: TOPAK H3 — Verification map: what is checked, what is proved, what must fail, and what neither claims
svg.desc: Every check and proof in the corpus. Two methods, two words (ADR-0046 §1): TLC checks seventeen TLA+ modules at small constants, each mutation failing the property it targets and each reachability witness violated; the TLA+ Proof System proves the invariants of thirteen of them, 2,417 obligations, under named assumptions and the absence of the mutations that break each. Then the policy floor's gates with a pinned proof checker; the reference's tests restating the properties; the trace harness that replays those tests through an operational model; the drift pins; and the lineage gate suite. Then the honesty layer: a proof is of the module, and what runs is neither checked nor proved.

text.tspan: Drift: records and modules pinned by the reference
: what it checks, what must fail, what is proved, and where its result is

svg.text: Seventeen modules and thirteen proof modules (G8 §9). Properties are invariants checked under Mut = "none"; each mutation changes the mechanism, never the property, and must produce a counterexample; each Never… witness must be violated, which shows the behaviour it names is reachable. The proof column gives each proof module and its obligations (ADR-0046 §4); its results file is <Module>-proof-results-2026.10.02.txt. Results files are dated and never change; every
proof results file and three TLC results files regenerate from a script, the rest are hand-assembled (G8 item 78). Pinned means listed in mechanism/corpus-pins.sha256.

Two of five exist, Anchor and BreakGlass, and are now proved and not only checked (ADR-0046 §4; ADR-0029 B25). Genesis, RulesFloor and Promotion are still owed. The trigger is unmet and remains optional;
bootstrap itself is deliberately not on the open list (G8 §7).

text.tspan: 5 · The honesty layer: what none of the above claims

svg.text: G7 said, as every checkpoint since G3 had: "no theorem is proved". G8 is the first checkpoint under which a property of the corpus is proved, in ADR-0046 §1's sense; MAP 2.3, the undeclared TLC-versus-TLAPS method, is closed (G8 §1).
Proved names a claim TLAPS discharged and the hypotheses it was discharged under: thirteen modules' invariants. Checked names TLC's evidence: the
mutations and witnesses at small constants. Neither is used of the running reference (ADR-0046 §1; G8 §5).
The trace validation is drift detection against a model of the code; a checked gate proof certifies an implication between two Cedar encodings, not the encoding
(G8 §8). The theorem-to-premise table says what each property assumed; it does not strengthen it.

text.tspan: Small constants; the prover as written

svg.text: "A property that holds at two principals and one epoch is evidence, not a proof" (T-0045-29, G5 §8): since B25 that residual bounds the mutations and witnesses
only. Model checking at practical constants: none yet (G8 item 75).
TLC and the prover are trust-root rows (T-0045-29, T-0045-31), trusted as written: no mutation of either is run, and the SMT backends' proofs are not rechecked
Batch 25's proofs were drafted, checked, mutation-tested and regenerated by the assistant and ratified by the custodian on the day; the condition meant to make
the cited digests someone else's was run by the drafter (G8 §4, §8).
The operational model was written from the code by the same hand on the same day: the link is mechanized, not independent (ADR-0033 A5).

text.tspan: What runs is neither checked nor proved

svg.text: "Thirteen modules' invariants are proved, and nothing about the running reference is" (G8 §8). "What runs is not the specification" (ADR-0045 §5, R1): no
refinement from the modules to the Rust exists and the build is asserted, not reproduced: trust-root rows T-0045-28 to 30, for every deployment.
"The gap is a debt, not a residual the archetype keeps" (R2): its owner is ADR-0033.

text.tspan: What the checker does not cover

svg.text: A holds° is cedar's own term folding with no query to check: 25 of the run's 29 holds rest on the engine's row (T-0045-3), not the checker's (G8 item 69).
The CPC signature is cvc5's own formalization, trusted as written; the three lying-solver controls test the wrapper's refusals, not the signature's rules (G7 §4).
Stage 1, trace validation: A5 (Batch 21), rerun at A6. Stage 2, a Lean model with differential testing, and stage 3, its compilation: "the chain proper", not begun.
The proofs make stage 2's target precise and do nothing else for it (ADR-0046 §2; G8 item 56).
The reproducible build (T-0045-30) is untouched. Each addendum says which stage it discharges, and the rows leave Annex A only on that addendum.
